name: Sensei Lanai, A Four Seasons Resort
insider_take: This wellness sanctuary on Hawaii's most secluded island transforms the former Lodge at Koele into a next-level mindfulness retreat where tech billionaire Larry Ellison's vision meets Four Seasons luxury.
whats_special: Sensei Lanai is the world's first resort dedicated entirely to wellness, featuring a groundbreaking partnership with wellness experts and cutting-edge biometric monitoring. The property sits at 1,700 feet elevation in Lanai's cool upcountry, surrounded by Cook pines and Norfolk pines originally planted in the 1920s. Only 96% of Lanai is privately owned by Oracle's Larry Ellison, making this one of the most exclusive island experiences in Hawaii.
pro_tip: Book the complimentary inter-island flights from Honolulu - they're included with your stay and offer stunning aerial views of the Hawaiian archipelago during the 25-minute journey.
dont_miss: The signature Sensei Spa treatments that incorporate your personal biometric data, and stargazing sessions on the clear upcountry nights. Take advantage of Lanai's unique position as Hawaii's "Pineapple Isle" - while commercial pineapple farming ended in 1992, you can still explore the abandoned Dole plantation roads that crisscross the island's interior.
pros: Comprehensive wellness retreat with integrated spa and fitness programs
Exclusive access to private Lanai island experiences
Personalized wellness consultations and custom itineraries
Four Seasons luxury service standards in intimate setting
cons: Remote island location requires additional travel planning
